cod.title: Nuketown is coming to Black Ops 7 and you won’t have to wait long
cod.description: The iconic Nuketown map is due to return in Black Ops 7, and players won’t have to wait too long to try it.
cod.source: Dexerto Latest Posts | Call Of Duty

cod.title: Warzone will have Tac Sprint after Black Ops 7 removal, but there’s a catch
cod.description: Call of Duty Warzone will have a big change in Black Ops 7 as Tac Sprint as we know it will be removed.
cod.source: Dexerto Latest Posts | Call Of Duty

cod.title: Major Warzone loadout changes coming with Black Ops 7 Season 1
cod.description: Loadout creating in Warzone is set to receive some major changes when Black Ops 7 integrates in Season 1.
cod.source: Dexerto Latest Posts | Call Of Duty
